definitions.explanation: The official time of a country or region, based on a specific time zone. Japan Standard Time (JST) is UTC+9.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What time is it in Japan Standard Time?

examples.japanese: ⟦アメリカ→アメリカ：01769_amerika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The United States has multiple standard time zones.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{九|きゅう}→九：00728_kyuu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Japan Standard Time is nine hours ahead of Coordinated Universal Time.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the phrase {日本|にほん}{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ} (JST). Japan uses a single time zone for the entire country.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本|にほん}{標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ} (Japan Standard Time, JST)
- {標準|ひょうじゅん}{時|じ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ (in standard time)
- ⟦{協定|きょうてい}→協定：05320_kyoutei⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧ (Coordinated Universal Time, UTC)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan does not observe daylight saving time. The country has used a single time zone (UTC+9) based on the 135th meridian since 1888.
